violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked corn at 46F, cut avocado at 46F, vegetable patties at 48F in 2 DR UC cooler (46F), yogurt at 46Fin 1 DR UC cooler (46F) in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all aforementioned food items from both of coolers.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed cooked chicken, cooked cauliflower, lentil soup in WIC without date markings.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC understands all TSC, prepared or cooked foods, including raw meats must have a date marking. PIC has date marked the aforementioned food items accordingly.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed live cockroaches inside and outside of dishwasher.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC discarded of cockroaches during inspection and provided EHS with most recent pest control report from 04/21/26. EHS recommended providing pest control services through a licensed pest control company biweekly to cover the life cycle of the cockroaches. PIC will email the invoice for pest control service to EHS.

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use

violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DR UC cooler at 46F, 1 DR cooler at 46F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. PIC will discontinue use of unit until repairs completed. BOMBAY VELVET (Inspection Date: 06/05/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: working containers of salt, pepper and different varieties of spices; squeeze bottles of oil and vinegar stored on cook line and throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all working containers.
